segments.text: People with better self-control reported trying less.
Across six studies, mostly self-reported, people with better self-control leaned more on habits, and said they spent less effort resisting.
But if you keep waiting to feel motivated, the feeling may show up late, or never.
So pick a fixed cue, like right after breakfast, then do just two minutes.
Try it today: pick one cue, and do two minutes after it.
